text.text_excerpt: We came here back in late June during a long weekend visit to New Orleans. Great po'boys here. We had the fried chicken and the roast beef. The fried chicken won by a mile, but the roast beef was good. The sweet potato fries were also very good. I thought this place had a great local vibe and was definitely a place I could see us going to on the weekends for a casual meal and to hang out. The prices are good, and I like the way you order up front, take a number, and then just hang out at the bar and wait or grab a table. It's also in a nice spot on Magazine Street.

I really like this spot. Perfect for game watching as there are at least 15 flat screens. Chances are they will have your game on. Large doors that open up wide onto Magazine Street. I go for the Roast beef Po-Boy. It is debris style and I would say it is one of the best in the city. The gravy has good flavor and whatever French bread they use is right on. Po-Boy fans know, it is all about the bread! Went on Sunday, (Saints played Monday) so there wasn't yet a crowd at 11:30. Plenty of tables, although it can be standing room only at times. Ordered two po-boys, one dressed, one not. Chowed down on some gravy cheese fries as well, these are so wrong yet so right! Perfect corner bar with go...

Good place to gather with friends and hang out. We were there for a New Orleans Pelicans watch party on Tuesday, March 10. My wife got a burger and liked it, we shared a debris fries and liked it, my wings were a bit on the dry side but that's because I got them plain with no sauce (they only had buffalo sauce, which I don't like, I wish they would offer more sauce choices). We got our food pretty quickly. It was also trivia night, we almost placed in the top 3, which would have gotten us a gift card.
